recipe.criteria: Single right leg knee curl from 180 to 80 degrees, torso leaning forward 30 degrees, fixed thigh pad and hand grips, left foot on platform, ankle roller and plate-loaded side lever. Four seconds curl and four seconds return; switch legs between sets.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
